W.note: Legible, well-built with clear focus and reduced motion, but the dark navy button barely glows and the dreamlike effect is subtle and the button looks small and plain.

X.note: Gradient pill blooms into a soft blurred halo with gentle overshoot and an arrow reveal, label stays legible, strong focus and reduced-motion handling, polished serif/sans page.

Y.note: Nice drifting color wash and long curves, but white label washes out against the pale gradient on hover and it uses transition:all.

Z.note: Glassy button with warm amber haze, breathing and drift, six well-named curves and thoughtful focus ring, though the effect is restrained and low contrast at rest.
